description: One advisory from OSV by its id or alias (GHSA-..., CVE-..., PYSEC-..., RUSTSEC-...): summary, details, severity (CVSS vectors), aliases, published and modified dates, withdrawn flag, every affected package with its ranges and fixed versions as published, and references. Price: 0.002 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"deps_get_advisory"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/advisory?id=GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm
